task.title: Add zero-touch campaign marker
task.prompt:
Goal: Add a small zero-touch campaign marker utility and prove it with focused tests. Outcome: Add a pure zero_touch_campaign_marker helper returning a deterministic dictionary with campaign_id, mode, and started flag.
Allowed paths: src/ade/zero_touch_campaign.py
Acceptance: helper is pure and deterministic; empty campaign_id or mode is rejected
Do not modify files outside the allowed paths.

task.prompt:
